TOKEN ISSUANCE ARCHITECTURAL VARIANTS (THREE INTEGRATION PATTERNS)
How agents obtain purpose tokens across existing enterprise identity infrastructures
Enables Okta, Entra ID, Ping, Keycloak, or Auth0 to support IBAE
without upgrading IdP core software. Lightweight wrapper handles minting.
Modern authorization servers with built-in RFC 9449 and custom
claims directly emit purpose tokens. Lowest operational latency.
Uses client certificate thumbprints rather than application-layer DPoP.
Verification occurs in gateway TLS termination. Identical downstream PEP.
